recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missing .device half of FHIR-37631 while preserving later Device/DeviceDefinition scope guidance; related Jira issues were used as context only and do not need separate reconciliation commits from this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-37631 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked Pharmacy to clarify the difference between .device and device performers on MedicationRequest and MedicationAdministration. The resolution made .device the device essential to administering the medication, with patch and syringe examples, and used pump examples for devices that actually perform administration.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit dc170b26ef270aa638b21e96e615b162e17b6d06 applied the performer-definition half of the issue to MedicationRequest.performer and MedicationAdministration.performer but did not update either .device definition. Current MedicationRequest.device already has max * so the reporter cardinality concern requires no additional edit.
additional_context: Both resources are active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-37973 later adjusted MedicationAdministration.performer/performer.actor and restated the old MedicationAdministration.device wording, but its resolution says the device/performer descriptions should correspond to MedicationRequest. FHIR-46961 later preserved MedicationAdministration.device as Device and added a Device/DeviceDefinition boundary comment, so this reconciliation left type and comment guidance unchanged. Pharmacy Confluence minutes confirm the cross-resource clarification intent, and no conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Changed the authoritative StructureDefinition XML for MedicationRequest.device and MedicationAdministration.device to the approved essential-device wording and patch/syringe examples, and synchronized the checked-in MedicationRequest SVG tooltip. Performer definitions, cardinalities, target types, and the later MedicationAdministration.device boundary comment were left intact.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml: updated MedicationRequest.device short and definition to describe an intended device essential to administration with patch/syringe examples.

source/medicationadministration/structuredefinition-MedicationAdministration.xml: updated MedicationAdministration.device short and definition to describe a device essential to administration while preserving the later Device/DeviceDefinition boundary comment.
